cutoff_qualification: A recorded snapshot label, not a final stop-time census or a per-job completion timestamp.

local_verification.full_cohort_raw_artifacts: verified by original sealed auditor; not all raw files are locally present
local_verification.ycb_context_projection: state tensor hashes match sealed full-context tensor metadata; full44MB context files are not copied

numerical_protocol.controls: Exact authenticated source replay in a fresh process; immutable detached caches; independently loaded checkpoint with identical BF16-rounded values lifted toFP32; audited dtype attributes/operations; strict fresh-process runtime; common noise/new reference, realized masks and action values; all six modality/target pairs.
numerical_protocol.existing_gap: V3/v4 compare precision using the original BF16 reference and cached actual state for vision/language. Production re-adapts the BF16-valued raw state in FP32 and generates one coherent new self-reference. V5 finds repeatability under a strict runtime bundle on one context. None approves the exact production scalar functions across the study.
numerical_protocol.non_redundancy: New function/reference/state mapping and deterministic backend contract require direct validation. Prior precision isolation remains valuable causal-factor evidence and is not discarded. The same stored contexts avoid unnecessary rollout collection.

outcomes.inconclusive: Missing calls, unresolved numerical degeneracy, technical failures or undefined diagnostics remain stated limitations; no automatic approval.
outcomes.negative: Retain failed contexts and reopen diagnosed integration/runtime/path issues or a scientifically explicit unsupported component. Do not dilute failure with favorable observations.
outcomes.positive: Candidate settings valid on this finite selection set move to independent held-out numerical verification; no efficacy or global accuracy claim follows.

numerical_protocol.question: Which numerical settings support the exact planned deterministic fp32 self-reference probe and its IG/path-gradient rankings across all retained task/checkpoint coverage?
numerical_protocol.runtime_and_storage: Use the four already authenticated matching Blackwell96 workers with disjoint exclusive outputs. Initial estimate is roughly30GPU minutes per170M context from measured fp32 m256 timing;1B is measured during this phase, not assumed equal. Shared volume150GB contains about50GB models. Full raw tensors are expected to add tens ofGB; monitor usage before expanding. No scientific artifacts are dropped for storage or speed.
numerical_protocol.sampling_precision: 24 planned contexts in12 fixed engineering episodes;21 available after documented early termination. This covers six retained strata, seeds and initial/later stages, not an efficacy precision guarantee. Two full finest-map repeats plus three repeated alpha/endpoint probes detect observed nondeterminism. Independent held-out coverage is a separate mandatory next gate.
numerical_protocol.scientific_value: Establish numerical validity of the actual producer, including its path-gradient control and primitive RMS responses, before a substantial paired ranking study. Separate source policy replay from deterministic offline probe execution.

criteria.completeness: At every tested budget, report signed/absolute and relative residuals. At a selected candidate require relative residual <=0.01 when the endpoint gap is above the declared target threshold. Degenerate or poorly conditioned relative residuals remain explicit and require separate raw-coordinate/response review, never automatic approval.
criteria.coordinates: Relative coordinate L1 difference <=0.01 for both IG and same-stream mean path gradient for each of m-vs-2m,2m-vs-4m,m-vs-4m. Exact identical zero vectors are recorded as degenerate, not as defined relative metrics. Other undefined coordinate comparisons cannot approve the setting.
criteria.group_order: Group Spearman >=0.99 for nonconstant scores and realized top5 overlap >=0.95 when its count is positive. When rounded count is zero, top5 is not applicable; separately require matching top-one and the full nonconstant-score Spearman criterion. Identical constant group vectors remain explicit degenerate controls, with deterministic tie fallback disclosed.
criteria.normalized_response: When the shared endpoint gap exceeds its recorded cutoff, normalized Q/L2/RMS area difference <=0.01. Below threshold, report undefined normalized outcomes and use raw criteria; do not remove the context from the numerical roster.
criteria.primitive_response: For each ranking, direction and budget comparison, max absolute RMS curve difference <=0.01 times that context/modality all-baseline RMS displacement; absolute raw RMS area difference <=0.005 times that displacement. Exact zero baseline displacement requires exactly equal raw curves and is separately labeled. These are numerical sensitivity criteria, not efficacy margins.
criteria.repeatability: Every saved fixed-alpha gradient, full IG/path-gradient repeat, endpoint action and repeated common response must be bitwise equal under the strict deterministic bundle. An observed failure reopens runtime diagnosis; it is not averaged away.
criteria.selection: One common target/modality setting can be selected only when all available coverage contexts support it. No averaging across failed contexts. The finest map is a comparator, not truth. If a ladder fails, retain it and record a reasoned new amendment before any extension; no production approval from a single adjacent pair.
criteria.source_and_runtime: Original source references and all immutable input identities must authenticate. Candidate operations must pass the strict fp32 audit; exact actual endpoints must match the new common fp32 self-reference.

validation.failure_rule: Keep all24 planned contexts and their episode identities, including3 unavailable late calls. Preserve infrastructure, source replay, dtype and deterministic-operation failures. Stop affected worker for technical diagnosis; no relaxed identity or warn-only fallback. Target/modality numerical failures remain explicit while other declared diagnostics continue. No context substitution.
validation.selection_rationale: Reuse the entire prospectively fixed v4 engineering bank as selection material. Earlier factor-control results were inspected and cannot be relabeled held-out. State has larger observed coordinate changes and receives the separately justified higher ladder. All modalities and both targets are retained.
validation.stopping_rule: Finish each prescribed ladder and all available v4 contexts, regardless of intermediate favorable results. Completion is diagnostics only. Select candidate settings after reviewing all per-context failures and cross-budget evidence, then use fresh disjoint episodes under the future full-trajectory sampling design for independent held-out validation. A failed holdout reopens engineering and is never reused as confirmation.

settings_transition.process_boundary: CUBLAS workspace configured before Torch in each fresh process

score_definition.qualification: Unit sigma squared is the exact pinned source definition, not a fitted parameter.

source_collection_protocol.collection: bf16 policy, same fixed episode-seed noise policy and controller/observation mapping as the tested runtime. No IG is computed during collection. No action-norm filter or success-based selection.
source_collection_protocol.failure_rule: Record missing selected calls from early termination with their episode denominator, without replacement. Keep failed attempts. Retry infrastructure failures on the same configured seed/input only. Missing task assets are an explicit setup blocker, not grounds to substitute an easier task.
source_collection_protocol.sampling_precision: Up to24 contexts in12 episodes across6 strata, chosen to cover task/model/stage and seed variation. This is a finite engineering coverage design, not population representativeness or adequate efficacy power. Report all per-context diagnostics and failures, no significance claim.
source_collection_protocol.selection: Four historically retained 170M tasks plus the retained authors-1B PickCube/StackCube cases; two independent seeds each; initial and call12 contexts. Seeds/call indices fixed here before collection. All13 executed policy calls are stored as small authenticated context sidecars; only specified calls are selected for this comparison.
